rule: Select actual product type before choosing a product-specific storyboard; never assume product capabilities from category alone.

cookware.policy: Treat existing 50 dish-based concepts as an unassigned draft pool, not 50 type-validated prompts. Match recipes to verified cookware capability, dimensions and user-supplied product identity.

global_policy: Every subcategory must define real purchasable product types before prompt assignment.
Product name and selected type determine plausible actions, scale, camera and setting.
Do not invent materials, attachments, electric features or cooking functions.
No generic if clauses in final prompt. Produce standalone prompts for the selected type.
Do not activate drafts without type-fit review and render QA.
